pairs.subject: repository-landing-document
pairs.evidence: src/app/guide/[category]/page.tsx:15 This context renders a catalog of many addressable guide pages (one route per category and topic). The golden path's own rule assigns that kind of artifact to docs-content-model, not to the repository's single front page. A case-insensitive search of src/app/guide for README, shields.io, CONTRIBUTING and 'npm install' found nothing, so this context does not compose the repository landing document.

techniques.evidence: src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/TopicHeader.tsx:28 The 'badge' here is an in-app UI chip that labels a desktop module. It is not a host-rendered status badge that links to evidence that can go red.
src/app/guide/[category]/page.tsx:18 This is web page SEO metadata. It is not the code host's repository description or topics.
src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/page.tsx:58 Each topic is a page looked up from a typed catalog. That is a content-model site, not the one front page that routes readers onward.

pairs.registryProposal: The registry map matched this subject to an in-app docs-site context, probably on tokens like 'guide' and 'badge'. The golden path already says a catalog of addressable pages belongs to docs-content-model. The matcher could use that boundary to stop pairing this subject with docs-site route contexts.
